description: Inspect the main switchboard (T1) and the sprinkler riser valve (T2), then return to the lobby pad. The facility plan is outdated: it shows fire door FD-2 open (it is closed) and does not know the refurbished open-plan office. During the mission the facility declares a temporary no-fly zone in server room S-1.
name: Indoor inspection — Building A, floor 1

timeline.description: Facility notice: aerial work platform operating in server room S-1 - temporary no-fly zone
